evidence_span.text: HSECs that lacked WDPCP at the beginning of ciliogenesis differentiated into fewer and shorter cilia compared with the controls

reviews.rationale: WDPCP silencing impaired ciliogenesis in human sinonasal epithelial cells. This directly supports its ciliary function, although the cellular and species context differs from mouse brain endothelium.

evidence_span.text: CHCM1/CHCHD6 knockdown causes severe defects in mitochondrial cristae morphology.

reviews.rationale: CHCHD6 knockdown directly disrupted mitochondrial cristae, with the abstract also reporting reduced ATP production and oxygen consumption. The experiments were outside the target brain-endothelial context.

evidence_span.text: TBC1D32 is involved in the development and function of cilia and is expressed in the developing hypothalamus and pituitary gland.

reviews.rationale: The paper explicitly links TBC1D32 to ciliary development and function while reporting gene-specific patient variants. Developing human hypothalamus and pituitary are indirect, not partial, contexts for postnatal mouse brain endothelial cells.

evidence_span.text: We have cloned, expressed in Escherichia coli, and purified the recombinant human mitochondrial MetAP isoform (MetAP1D). The full-length enzyme and a truncated form lacking the mitochondrial targeting sequence (residues 1-55) have been characterized as metal-requiring proteases, with Co2+ being the best activator.

reviews.rationale: Direct biochemical characterization establishes METAP1D as a mitochondrial metal-dependent protease, consistent with methionine aminopeptidase processing. The recombinant in-vitro system is indirect to mouse brain endothelium.
